entities.name: László Orbán
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: László Orbán was an amateur boxer from Hungary, who won the silver medal in the lightweight division at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, West Germany. In the final he was defeated by Poland's Jan Szczepański on points, (5:0).
